description: Source code for a command-line utility that performs encryption/decryption of firmware files using XOR-based header cryptography, with options for input/output files and decrypt/encrypt mode.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the command-line utility.

methods.name: crypt_header
methods.description: Performs XOR-based encryption/decryption on a buffer using two key strings.

methods.name: crypt_file
methods.description: Handles reading the input file, encrypting/decrypting its contents, and writing to the output file.

methods.name: check_params
methods.description: Validates that input and output filenames are specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, processes command-line arguments, and orchestrates the encryption/decryption process.
